name: Feral Gargun
traits: Medium Monstrous Humanoid with 30-ft. land speed and 60-ft. black-and-white darkvision. Full ancestry gives +4 Strength, +2 Dexterity, +4 Constitution, −2 Intelligence, and −2 Charisma.
Full ancestry gives +2 natural armor. Cold resistance 5 applies to both mundane and magical cold damage.

Two racial Hit Dice give 2d8, BAB +2, base Fortitude +0, Reflex +3, and Will +3. One racial feat and 5 × (2 + Intelligence modifier) skill points. Racial class skills are Climb, Hide, Jump, Listen, Search, Spot, and Survival.
Racial proficiency covers simple weapons. Armor and shield proficiency come from other sources, such as class.
The full ancestry has two claws dealing 1d6 piercing and slashing damage each. In a full attack with a manufactured weapon, a free claw can be used as a secondary attack.

Powerful Build counts size as one category larger when advantageous on opposed checks with size modifiers and against size-dependent special attacks. It enables weapons one size larger and preserves actual space and reach. It stacks with size changes that preserve the trait.
Mountain Movement treats standing long jumps and high jumps as running jumps. An accelerated Climb check moves half speed as a move action without the usual −5 penalty.
Acclimated removes the Dungeon Master’s Guide p. 90 altitude penalties and persists after time at lower elevations.
Goliath Blood counts the Feral Gargun as a Goliath for effects keyed to race, including race-restricted magic items.
The language entry gives Gol-Kaa. Favored class Barbarian. Level adjustment +2 gives ECL 4 with the two racial Hit Dice before adding class levels.
The optional four-level Feral Gargun monster class starts with +2 Strength, −2 Intelligence, −2 Charisma, 30-ft. speed, darkvision 60 ft., Cold resistance 5, Goliath Blood, and Mountain Movement.
Monster-class level 1 gives 1d8, BAB +1, base Fortitude +0, Reflex +2 and Will +2, one feat, and two 1d4 claws. Level 2 adds +2 Strength, +2 Constitution, +1 natural armor, and Acclimated.

Monster-class level 3 adds the second 1d8, BAB +2 total, base Fortitude +0, Reflex +3 and Will +3, Powerful Build, and 1d6 claws. Level 4 adds +2 Constitution and +2 Dexterity and brings natural armor to +2 total.

Skill points for the progression are (2 + Intelligence modifier) × 4 at 1st level and (2 + Intelligence modifier) at 3rd. The four levels incorporate level adjustment. Complete the progression before multiclassing. Table 4–4 lists CR 1, 1, 2, and 2.
